review_title: One of the most customizable project management tool on the market
pros: Clickup is really easy to use but also really customizable. We have several teams in my company and each of them has its way of working, ClickUp is enabling us to fit their requirements. Also, it's very visual and there are a lot of automation possibilities, helping us to gain significant time.
cons: The UX is sometimes too heavy: it can become difficult to navigate from one view to the other as there could be lot of items on a single page. Also, it can become difficult to go through icons list, especially if you set lot of different possibilities - the system does not help managing replicates at scale.
general_comments: Overall, it has been very pleasant to work on ClickUp and get organized in a 200 FTEs organization. Yet, it has been necessary to streamline our way of working and centralize how to use the tool as it can become quickly messy if you don't administrate it.
